svg.title: Still water makes the mirror
svg.desc: Diagram of a level symmetrical reflection with a focus callout on the reflected distant mountain. Focus on the reflected distant feature. Calm water preserves mirror detail. A centred horizon can be deliberate
svg.text: MOUNTAIN AND ITS MIRROR IN CALM LAKE WATER

g.text: Still water preserves the mirrored geometry
Wind breaks reflected shapes into ripples

svg.text: Focus on the reflected distant feature
A centred horizon can be deliberate
